def chg(f):

def table(head,rows,num=(),cls=None,raw=(),wrapc=(),stack=False,hm=()):
    lab=lambda x: html.escape(__import__('re').sub('<[^>]+>','',x),quote=True)
    h=''.join('<th'+(' class="'+' '.join(k for k,v in (('n',i in num),('hm',i in hm)) if v)+'"' if (i in num or i in hm) else '')+f'>{x}</th>' for i,x in enumerate(head))
    def td(j,x):
        c=' '.join(k for k,v in (('n',j in num),('w',j in wrapc),('hm',j in hm)) if v)
        t=x if (j in raw or str(x).startswith("&lt;")) else e(x)
        return f'<td{" class=\""+c+"\"" if c else ""} data-label="{lab(head[j])}">{t}</td>'
    b=''.join((f'<tr class="{cls(i)}">' if cls and cls(i) else '<tr>')+''.join(td(j,x) for j,x in enumerate(r))+'</tr>' for i,r in enumerate(rows))
    return f'<div class="wrap{" stack" if stack else ""}"><table><thead><tr>{h}</tr></thead><tbody>{b}</tbody></table></div>'
def pathrow(r):
    opp=e(r['opponent'])+(f"<small>{e(r['earlier'])}</small>" if r['earlier'] else '')

    site=e(r['site'])+f"<small>{' · '.join(bits)}</small>"+(f"<small>Also possible: {e(r['alts'])}</small>" if r.get('alts') else '')
    return [r['round'],r['when'],opp,f"{r['opp_share']}%",f"{r['win_prob']}%",site]

def _split(t):
    t=(t or '').strip()
    if not t or t.startswith(('Named players','Roster only','No ','Limited')): return []
    out=[];d=0;cur=''
    for ch in t:
        if ch=='(' : d+=1
        if ch==')' : d=max(0,d-1)
        if ch==',' and d==0: out.append(cur);cur=''
        else: cur+=ch
    out.append(cur)
    res=[]
    for x in out:
        x=x.strip().rstrip('.')
        if not x: continue
        if '(' in x and x.endswith(')'):
            n,l=x.split('(',1); res.append({"name":n.strip(),"line":l[:-1].strip()})
        else: res.append({"name":x,"line":""})
    return res
def _tcard(r,nxt=False):
    p=_pm.get(r['team'])
    if nxt: chip=(f'<span class="chip">Lindale wins {p["win_prob"]}%</span>' if p else '')
    else: chip=(f'<span class="chip">{p["opp_share"]}% chance it\'s them</span><span class="chip">Lindale wins {p["win_prob"]}%</span>' if p else '')
    pl=r.get('plist') or _split(r.get('players',''))
    cards=''.join(f'<div class="pl"><b>{e(x["name"])}</b>'+(f'<span>{e(x["line"])}</span>' if x['line'] else '')+'</div>' for x in pl)
    if not pl: cards=f'<div class="pl"><b>Players</b><span>{e(r.get("players",""))}</span></div>'
    head=f'<b>{e(r["team"])}</b><span class="rd">{e(r["round"])} · {e(r["record"])}</span>{chip}'
    body=f'<div class="plg">{cards}<div class="pl wt"><b>What to watch</b><ul>{_li(r["watch"])}</ul></div></div>'
    if nxt: return f'<div class="tb nx"><div class="th">{head}</div>{body}</div>'
    return f'<details class="tb"><summary class="th">{head}</summary>{body}</details>'

    pl=w.get('plist') or _split(w.get('players',''))
    cards=''.join(f'<div class="pl"><b>{e(x["name"])}</b>'+(f'<span>{e(x["line"])}</span>' if x['line'] else '')+'</div>' for x in pl)
    if not pl: cards=f'<div class="pl"><b>Players</b><span>{e(w.get("players",""))}</span></div>'
    return f'<details class="tb"><summary class="th">{head}</summary>{info}<div class="plg">{cards}<div class="pl wt"><b>What to watch</b><ul>{_li(w["watch"])}</ul></div></div></details>'

def _wxsec(w):
    cols=w.get('cols') or ['Time','Temp','Feels like','Wind','Gusts']
    t=''.join('<tr>'+''.join(f'<td>{e(c)}</td>' for c in r)+'</tr>' for r in w['rows'])
    li=''.join(f'<li>{e(x)}</li>' for x in w['wear'])
    return (f'<section id="weather"><h2>Game-night weather and what to wear</h2>'
      f'<p class="lab" style="margin:0 0 6px">{e(w["game"])} · {e(w["when"])} · {e(w["site"])}{"" if w["site_status"]=="Set" else " (site suggested, not announced)"}</p>'
      f'<p>{e(w["headline"])}</p>{('<div class="tw"><table><thead><tr>'+''.join('<th>'+e(c)+'</th>' for c in cols)+'</tr></thead><tbody>'+t+'</tbody></table></div>') if w['rows'] else ''}'
      f'{("<h3 style=\"margin:12px 0 4px;font-size:1rem\">What to wear</h3><ul style=\"margin:0 0 8px;padding-left:18px\">"+li+"</ul>") if w["wear"] else ""}'
      f'<p class="lab">Forecast from {e(w["source"])} as of {e(w["as_of"])}. Refreshed with each tracker update; check again before you leave.</p></section>\n')

<style>
/* Layout: one scanning column, summary first (next game, odds), then path, bracket, charts, then reference tables. */
:root{{--bg:#f5f6f8;--panel:#ffffff;--ink:#0b0d12;--muted:#4a505c;--line:#d8dbe2;--accent:#003399;--upset:#c9781c;--bar:#8c919c;

@media (prefers-color-scheme:dark){{:root:not([data-theme="light"]){{--bg:#0a0b0f;--panel:#14161c;--ink:#f2f4f8;--muted:#a0a6b4;--line:#2a2d36;--accent:#6ea6f5;--upset:#e9a14a;--bar:#5b6070;color-scheme:dark}}}}
:root[data-theme="dark"]{{--bg:#0a0b0f;--panel:#14161c;--ink:#f2f4f8;--muted:#a0a6b4;--line:#2a2d36;--accent:#6ea6f5;--upset:#e9a14a;--bar:#5b6070;color-scheme:dark}}
*{{box-sizing:border-box}}
body{{margin:0;background:var(--bg);color:var(--ink);font-family:var(--body);font-size:15px;line-height:1.45}}
main{{max-width:1080px;margin:0 auto;padding:28px 20px 48px;display:grid;gap:30px}}
h1,h2,h3{{font-family:var(--display);font-weight:600;margin:0;text-wrap:balance;letter-spacing:.01em}}
body{{border-top:10px solid #003399;border-image:linear-gradient(#0b0d12 0 4px,#003399 4px 10px) 10 0 0 0/10px 0 0 0 stretch}} .brand{{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:18px;margin-bottom:6px}} .logo{{width:104px;height:auto;flex:0 0 auto}} :root[data-theme="dark"] .logo{{background:#fff;border-radius:14px;padding:8px}} @media (prefers-color-scheme:dark){{:root:not([data-theme="light"]) .logo{{background:#fff;border-radius:14px;padding:8px}}}}
h1{{font-size:2.5rem;line-height:1.05}} h2{{font-size:1.55rem;margin-bottom:10px}} h3{{font-size:1.2rem;margin:14px 0 6px}}
p{{margin:0 0 8px;max-width:70ch;text-wrap:pretty}} section{{min-width:0}}
.lab{{color:var(--muted);font-size:.8rem}}
.stamp{{display:inline-block;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:999px;padding:2px 10px;margin:8px 0 12px;color:var(--muted);font-size:.8rem}}
.next{{background:var(--panel);border:1px solid var(--line);border-left:5px solid var(--accent);border-radius:8px;padding:18px 20px;display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(210px,1fr));gap:18px;align-items:center}}
.next .opp{{font-family:var(--display);font-size:2.1rem;font-weight:600;line-height:1.1;display:block}}
.big{{font-family:var(--display);font-weight:600;font-size:2.3rem;line-height:1;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;display:block}}
.cards{{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(150px,1fr));gap:12px}}
.card{{background:var(--panel);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:8px;padding:14px 16px;display:grid;gap:4px}}
.wrap{{overflow-x:auto;background:var(--panel);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:8px}}
.tw{{overflow-x:auto}} table{{border-collapse:collapse;width:100%;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;font-size:.88rem}}
th,td{{text-align:left;padding:7px 11px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);white-space:normal;overflow-wrap:anywhere}} td.n,th.n{{white-space:nowrap}} th{{white-space:nowrap}} td:not(.n):not(.w){{min-width:70px}}
tbody tr:last-child td{{border-bottom:0}}
th{{color:var(--muted);font-weight:600;font-size:.76rem;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.04em}}
.n{{text-align:right}} tr.me td{{font-weight:600}} tr.g0 td{{border-top:2px solid var(--muted)}} tr.up td:last-child{{color:var(--upset);font-weight:600}}
.two{{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(300px,1fr));gap:26px;align-items:start}}
.bracket{{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(190px,1fr));gap:14px;align-items:center}}
.bcol{{display:grid;gap:10px}} .bbox{{background:var(--panel);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:8px;padding:8px 12px}}
.brow{{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;padding:2px 0;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}} .brow.me{{font-weight:600;color:var(--accent)}}
svg{{width:100%;height:auto;display:block}} svg text{{fill:var(--muted);font-size:12px;font-family:var(--body)}} svg text.val{{fill:var(--ink);font-weight:600}}
rect.hi{{fill:var(--accent)}} rect.lo{{fill:var(--bar)}} .grid{{stroke:var(--line)}} .zero{{stroke:var(--muted)}} .ref{{stroke:var(--muted);stroke-dasharray:4 4}}
circle.won{{fill:var(--accent);fill-opacity:.8}} circle.ups{{fill:var(--upset);fill-opacity:.9}} circle.me{{stroke:var(--ink);stroke-width:2;fill-opacity:1}}
.key{{display:flex;gap:16px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin:6px 0}} .key i{{display:inline-block;width:10px;height:10px;border-radius:50%;margin-right:6px}}
ul{{margin:0;padding-left:1.1em}} .sugg{{border-left:4px solid var(--upset);background:var(--panel);padding:8px 12px;border-radius:4px;margin:0 0 12px}} li{{margin:3px 0}}
@media (min-width:1500px){{body{{font-size:16.5px}} main{{max-width:1280px;padding-top:40px}} h1{{font-size:2.9rem}} h2{{font-size:1.75rem}}}}
@media (min-width:2200px){{body{{font-size:18px}} main{{max-width:1440px}}}}
nav{{display:flex;gap:6px 16px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin:0 0 12px;font-size:.88rem}} nav a{{color:var(--accent);text-decoration:none;font-weight:600}} nav a:hover{{text-decoration:underline}} section[id],.two[id]{{scroll-margin-top:12px}}
td.w{{white-space:normal;min-width:150px}} td small{{display:block;color:var(--muted);font-size:.78rem;white-space:normal;font-weight:400}}
.wrap{{background:linear-gradient(to right,var(--panel) 30%,transparent),linear-gradient(to left,var(--panel) 30%,transparent),linear-gradient(to right,rgba(0,0,0,.18),transparent 12px),linear-gradient(to left,rgba(0,0,0,.18),transparent 12px);background-repeat:no-repeat;background-size:40px 100%,40px 100%,14px 100%,14px 100%;background-position:left,right,left,right;background-attachment:local,local,scroll,scroll;background-color:var(--panel)}}
.bracket{{align-items:stretch}} .bcol{{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:6px}} .bbody{{flex:1;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:space-around;gap:10px}}
.hbars{{display:grid;gap:7px}} .hb{{display:grid;grid-template-columns:96px 1fr 44px;gap:10px;align-items:center;font-size:.9rem}} .hb b{{text-align:right;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}}
.track{{background:transparent;height:16px;display:block}} .track i{{display:block;height:100%;background:var(--bar);border-radius:3px}} .hb.me{{font-weight:600}} .hb.me .track i{{background:var(--accent)}}
.pl{{display:block;box-sizing:border-box;padding:10px 12px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:8px;background:var(--panel)}} .pl b{{color:var(--accent)}} .pl span{{display:block;margin-top:2px;font-size:.9rem;color:var(--muted)}} .plg,.tg{{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(min(280px,100%),1fr));gap:8px;align-items:start}} .plg{{align-items:stretch}} .pl,.tc{{min-width:0;overflow-wrap:anywhere}} .tc{{display:grid;gap:4px;padding:10px 12px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:8px;background:var(--panel)}} .tb{{margin:0 0 10px}} details.tb{{border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:8px;padding:0 12px;background:var(--panel)}} details.tb[open]{{padding-bottom:12px}} details.tb>summary{{cursor:pointer;margin:0;padding:10px 0;list-style:revert}} details.tb[open]>summary{{margin-bottom:2px}} details.tb>summary::-webkit-details-marker{{display:none}} details.tb>summary::before{{content:'\\25B8';color:var(--muted);transition:transform .15s}} details.tb[open]>summary::before{{transform:rotate(90deg)}} .tb .th{{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:4px 10px;align-items:center;margin:0 0 6px}} .tb .th b{{font-size:1.05rem}} .tb.nx .th b{{color:var(--accent)}} .pl.wt{{grid-column:1/-1}} .pl.wt ul{{margin:4px 0 0 18px;padding:0}} .pl.wt li{{margin:3px 0}} .tc .th{{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:2px 10px;align-items:baseline}} .tc .th b{{color:var(--accent)}} .tc .chips{{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:6px}} .tc ul{{margin:2px 0 0 18px;padding:0}} .tc li{{margin:3px 0}} .wc{{border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:8px;background:var(--panel);padding:0 14px;margin-top:8px}} .wc summary{{cursor:pointer;padding:12px 0;display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:6px 10px;align-items:center}} .wc .rd{{color:var(--muted);font-size:.85rem}} .chip{{font-size:.75rem;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:99px;padding:1px 8px}} .wc ul{{margin:4px 0 12px 18px;padding:0}} .wc li{{margin:3px 0}} .pp{{margin:0 0 6px;font-size:.92rem}}
.only-small{{display:none}} .rnd{{margin:0 0 14px}} .rh{{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;justify-content:space-between;align-items:baseline;gap:2px 12px;margin:0 0 6px;padding-top:8px;border-top:2px solid var(--line)}} .rh h3{{margin:0}} .tbp{{border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:8px;padding:0 12px 4px;background:var(--panel)}} .tbp .th{{padding:8px 0}} .rnd .th{{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center;gap:2px 8px}} .rnd .th .rd{{font-size:.85rem}} .rnd details.tb>summary{{padding:8px 0}} .rnd .tb{{margin:0 0 6px}}
@media (max-width:640px){{
main{{padding:20px 14px 40px;gap:24px}} .rnd .th .rd{{flex:1 1 100%}} h1{{font-size:1.7rem}} .logo{{width:68px}} .brand{{gap:12px}}
.stack table,.stack tbody{{display:block;width:100%}} .stack thead{{display:none}}
.stack tr{{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:6px 12px;padding:10px 12px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}} .stack tbody tr:last-child{{border-bottom:0}}
.stack td{{display:block;border:0;padding:0;white-space:normal;min-width:0;text-align:left}} .stack td.w{{grid-column:1/-1}}
.stack td::before{{content:attr(data-label);display:block;color:var(--muted);font-size:.68rem;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.04em;font-weight:400}}
.stack tr.g0 td{{border-top:0}} .stack tr.g0{{border-top:2px solid var(--muted)}}
.hm{{display:none}} .wrap:not(.stack) th,.wrap:not(.stack) td{{padding:7px 8px}} .wrap:not(.stack) th{{white-space:normal;font-size:.7rem}} .scatter{{display:none}} .only-small{{display:block}} .bracket{{grid-template-columns:1fr}} .hb{{grid-template-columns:84px 1fr 40px}}
}}
tr[hidden]{{display:none!important}} .tog td{{border-top:0;padding-top:2px}} .tog button{{font:inherit;font-weight:600;color:var(--accent);background:none;border:0;padding:6px 0;cursor:pointer}} .tog button:hover{{text-decoration:underline}} td.tc::before{{display:none!important}}
@media print{{tr[hidden]{{display:table-row!important}} .tog{{display:none}} nav{{display:none}} body{{background:#fff;font-size:11px}} main{{padding:0;gap:16px;max-width:none}} .wrap{{overflow:visible}} th,td{{white-space:normal;padding:3px 6px}} tr,.card,.bbox,.next,svg{{break-inside:avoid}} h2,h3{{break-after:avoid}}}}
</style></head><body><main>
<header>
<div class="brand"><img class="logo" src="{LOGO}" alt="Lindale Eagles logo: an eagle inside an outline of Texas" width="104" height="104"><div><h1>Lindale 4A Division&nbsp;I playoff tracker</h1>
<div class="stamp">Odds as of {d}</div></div></div>
<nav aria-label="Page sections"><a href="#next">Next game</a>{wxnav}<a href="#watch">Players</a><a href="#path">Road</a><a href="#games">This round</a><a href="#charts">Charts</a><a href="#results">Results</a></nav>
<p class="lab">Lindale is <b>{pct(lin['p_title'])}</b> to win state and <b>{pct(lin['p_region'])}</b> to win&nbsp;Region&nbsp;II. {e(fav['team'])} is the title favorite at {pct(fav['p_title'])}. Odds are estimates from simulated brackets built on MaxPreps ratings; single games swing a lot, so read them as rough chances. Refreshed after each round.</p>
</header>
<section class="next" id="next">
<div><span class="lab">Lindale's next game: {e(nx['round'])} round</span><span class="opp">{e(nx['opponent'])}</span><span>{e(nx['when'])}</span></div>
<div><span class="lab">Site ({e(nx['site_status'])})</span><div>{e(nx['site'])}</div><span class="lab">{nx['capacity']:,} seats, about {nx['drive_miles']} miles and {e(nx['drive_time'])} from Lindale</span></div>
<div><span class="big">{nx['win_prob']}%</span><span class="lab">Lindale's chance to win</span></div>
</section>
{wxhtml}<section id="watch"><h2>Key players</h2><h3 style="margin:0 0 8px;font-size:1rem">Lindale</h3><div class="plg">{mine}</div>{nextblock}<p class="lab" style="margin-top:8px">Stats come from local news reports (Tyler Morning Telegraph, ETBlitz, Longview News-Journal, Henderson News, High Plains Pundit). Season totals run through Nov 19; game lines from the Nov 20-21 area round were added from recaps published Nov 21. Where no named players turned up in sources, the card says so. Most teams only have box scores, so this is not a scouting report. Updated by hand after each round.</p></section>
<section><h2>Lindale's odds, game by game</h2><div class="cards">{cards}</div></section>
<section id="path"><h2>Lindale's road to the title</h2>
<p class="sugg"><b>Only the regional site is confirmed.</b> Lindale vs. Henderson is Fri Nov 27 at 7 p.m. at Rose Stadium in Tyler (Lindale ISD and Tyler Morning Telegraph); gates open 5:30, tickets on Hudl only ($8 adults, $5 students presale; $10 at the gate). The state final at AT&amp;T Stadium is also set. Every other site is a suggestion based on where Lindale has played before, and any of them can change.</p>
<p class="lab" style="margin-bottom:10px">Round by round, assuming Lindale advances. Open an opponent for its key players. "Set" sites are announced; "suggested" sites are estimates based on where Lindale has played before (Nacogdoches or Tyler for East Texas, Commerce, Mesquite or Mansfield for the Dallas area, Denton, Fort Worth or Abilene for a state semifinal against a Region I team; the last three Region I vs. Region II 4A semifinals were at Denton's Collins Complex in 2023, Abilene's Shotwell Stadium in 2024 and Fort Worth's Knight Stadium in 2025). Miles are from Lindale and approximate.</p>
{_road}
<details class="tb"><summary class="th"><b>Full Region II bracket</b><span class="rd">chance to win each round</span></summary><div class="bracket">{col('Regional round',4,'p_regional')}{col('Region final',8,'p_region')}</div></details>
</section>
<section id="games"><h2>This round's games: regional round (Fri, Sat)</h2>
{table(['Matchup','Region','When','Site','Ratings favorite','Favorite wins / result'],[[r['matchup'],r['region'],r['when'],r['site'],r['favorite'],(r['final'] if r.get('final') else f"{r['fav_prob']}%")] for r in games],num=(),stack=True,wrapc=(0,3,4,5),cls=lambda i:'me' if games[i]['lindale_path'] else '')}
<p class="lab" style="margin-top:8px">Region II games, the ones on Lindale's side of the bracket, are in bold. None of the regional games has been played. "Set" sites are stated by a named source: MaxPreps' bracket (Region III and Calallen-La Vernia), the Tyler Morning Telegraph (Pine Tree-Paris, Lindale-Henderson), Lindale ISD (Lindale-Henderson), the Fort Worth Star-Telegram (Springtown-Canyon), and Dave Campbell's Texas Football and High School Football America (all eight, including Decatur-Randall in Vernon and Canyon Lake-Davenport at Warrior Coliseum).</p></section>
<div class="two" id="charts">
<section><h2>Title odds, top eight teams</h2>{barsvg}<h3>Upsets</h3><ul>{''.join(f"<li>{e(r['winner'])} {e(r['score'])} over {e(r['loser'])}, which was favored by {r['pred_margin']:g}</li>" for r in ups)}</ul></section>
<section><h2>Ratings vs. results so far</h2><p>Favorites have won <b>{sum(r['fav_won'] for r in results)}</b> of <b>{len(results)}</b> playoff games. The dashed line marks a perfect prediction.</p>
<div class="key lab"><span><i style="background:var(--accent)"></i>Favorite won</span><span><i style="background:var(--upset)"></i>Upset</span></div><div class="scatter">{scsvg}</div><p class="lab only-small">The chart shows on wider screens. The upsets list is on this page too.</p></section>
</div>
<section id="results"><h2>Previous results</h2><h3>Lindale's season</h3>
<p>Lindale is <b>{w}-{n-w}</b>, scoring <b>{sum(r['points_for'] for r in season)/n:.1f}</b> points a game and allowing <b>{sum(r['points_against'] for r in season)/n:.1f}</b>.</p>
{table(['Date','Opponent','Game type','Result','Margin'],[[r['date'],r['opponent'],r['type'],r['result'],f"{r['margin']:+d}"] for r in season],num=(4,),stack=True)}
<h3>Playoff results, all teams</h3>
{table(['Round','Region','Winner','Score','Loser','Ratings call'],[[r['round'],r['region'],r['winner'],r['score'],r['loser'],r['ratings_call']] for r in results],stack=True,cls=lambda i:('me ' if 'Lindale' in (results[i]['winner'],results[i]['loser']) else '')+('' if results[i]['fav_won'] else 'up'))}</section>
<section><h2>Every team still alive</h2>
{table(['Team','Record','Region','Rating','Win area','Win regional','Win region','Reach final','Win title'],[[r['team'],r['record'],r['region'],f"{r['rating']:.2f}",pct(r['p_area']),pct(r['p_regional']),pct(r['p_region']),pct(r['p_final']),pct(r['p_title'])] for r in sorted(odds,key=lambda r:-r['rating'])],num=(3,4,5,6,7,8),hm=(1,2,3,4,5),cls=lambda i:'me' if sorted(odds,key=lambda r:-r['rating'])[i]['team']=='Lindale' else '')}</section>
</main>
<script>
(function(){{var tb=document.querySelector("#path tbody");if(!tb)return;
var g,groups=[];[].slice.call(tb.rows).forEach(function(r){{if(r.classList.contains("g0")){{g=[r];groups.push(g)}}else g.push(r)}});
groups.forEach(function(g){{if(g.length<2)return;var others=g.slice(1),tr=document.createElement("tr"),td=document.createElement("td"),b=document.createElement("button");
tr.className="tog";td.colSpan=6;td.className="w tc";b.type="button";
function set(open){{others.forEach(function(r){{r.hidden=!open}});b.setAttribute("aria-expanded",open?"true":"false");b.textContent=open?"Hide the other opponents":"Show "+others.length+" other possible opponent"+(others.length>1?"s":"")}}
b.onclick=function(){{set(b.getAttribute("aria-expanded")!=="true")}};set(false);td.appendChild(b);tr.appendChild(td);g[0].parentNode.insertBefore(tr,g[0].nextSibling)}})}})();
</script>
</body></html>'''
import os; os.makedirs('static',exist_ok=True); open('static/index.html','w').write(P); print(len(P))
